Aletheia Extension Test Fixtures

This site hosts test pages for automated verification of the Aletheia browser extension. These pages contain intentionally crafted content to test security features.

Age Gate Tests (Issue #104)

  • test-adult.html - Contains <meta name="rating" content="adult">
  • test-rta.html - Contains RTA pattern in rating meta tag
  • test-mature.html - Contains <meta name="rating" content="mature"> (allowed)
  • test-clean.html - No rating meta tag (allowed)

XSS Protection Tests

  • test-xss-script.html - Script tag injection test
  • test-xss-img.html - Image onerror injection test
  • test-xss-event.html - Event handler injection test
Purpose: These fixtures are used by Playwright E2E tests to verify that the Aletheia extension correctly:
  • Blocks operation on age-restricted pages
  • Allows operation on non-restricted pages
  • Sanitizes selected text to prevent XSS attacks
